import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif, RFE
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Generate complex dataset
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=500, n_features=20, n_informative=10, n_redundant=5, n_classes=3, random_state=42)
feature_names = [f'f{i}' for i in range(20)]

# Standardize the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# PCA: find components for 90% variance
pca = PCA()
pca.fit(X_scaled)
n_pca = np.argmax(np.cumsum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_) >= 0.90) + 1
X_pca = PCA(n_components=n_pca).fit_transform(X_scaled)

# LDA: supervised reduction (n_classes - 1 components)
lda = LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(n_components=2)
X_lda = lda.fit_transform(X_scaled, y)

# SelectKBest: top 10 features
skb = SelectKBest(score_func=f_classif, k=10)
X_skb = skb.fit_transform(X_scaled, y)

# RFE: top 8 features
rfe = RFE(estimator=LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000), n_features_to_select=8)
X_rfe = rfe.fit_transform(X_scaled, y)

# Print comprehensive comparison summary
print("=== Dimensionality Reduction Comparison ===")
print(f"Original shape: {X_scaled.shape}")
print(f"PCA (90% variance): {X_pca.shape} - preserves global variance")
print(f"LDA (supervised): {X_lda.shape} - preserves class separation")
print(f"SelectKBest (top 10): {X_skb.shape} - preserves individual feature-target relationships")
print(f"RFE (top 8): {X_rfe.shape} - preserves feature subset for model performance")
print(f"\nPCA components explain: {np.cumsum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)[:n_pca].round(3)}")
print(f"LDA selected features: {np.array(feature_names)[skb.get_support()][:10].tolist()}")
print(f"RFE selected features: {np.array(feature_names)[rfe.support_].tolist()}")
